Lines.Speaker: NARRATOR
Lines.Text: It was a little after two in the morning when the lights on the third floor came back on.

Lines.Speaker: GUEST
Lines.Text: Thanks for having me. It is late, though.

Lines.Speaker: HOST
Lines.Text: It is. Let's begin with the night itself.

Lines.Speaker: HOST
Lines.Text: You were the only one in the building that night.

Lines.Speaker: GUEST
Lines.Text: I was. Or I thought I was, anyway.

Lines.Speaker: GUEST
Lines.Text: Then the elevator started moving on its own.

Lines.Speaker: GUEST
Lines.Text: I waited.  And then I took the stairs.

Lines.Speaker: NARRATOR
Lines.Text: The stairwell was cold, and the door at the top was already open.

Lines.Speaker: GUEST
Lines.Text: Not right away. I wanted to see it for myself first.

Lines.Speaker: GUEST
Lines.Text: Nothing at all. That was the strange part.

Lines.Speaker: NARRATOR
Lines.Text: By morning, the lights were off again, and the elevator stood still on the ground floor.

Lines.Speaker: HOST
Lines.Text: Thank you for telling us this.
